description: Synthetic e-commerce orders, one row per order. All data governed by this contract is generated by datarefinery.fixtures.

columns.name: order_date
columns.note: Canonical ISO date. alternate_formats are the only candidates the drift detector may propose as repairs.

columns.name: amount
columns.note: Amount in the row's own currency. Values with more than 2 decimal places are rejected, never rounded.

columns.name: weight_kg
columns.note: reference is the declared expected distribution, used for unit-scale drift only when no earlier accepted batch is available.

derived.name: amount_usd
derived.rule: amount * rate[currency] rounded to 2 decimal places with the FX table's declared rounding mode
